summary: g0001 zeroes a newly allocated internal read buffer; g0002 and g0003 change comments. The old harness also calls png_start_read_image after png_read_update_info and enables interlace handling after row initialization. The supplied evidence does not establish whether either ordering issue prevents a supported read, so maintenance necessity remains unknown.
